title: Judith Leyster's paintings
summary: Dutch Golden Age painter Judith Leyster ran her own workshop and painted genre scenes, portraits and still lifes; her first known signed works date from 1629.
why: A leading painter whose whole body of work was nearly lost under other names.

unsung.contribution: Painted acclaimed genre scenes and portraits as an independent master.
unsung.recognition: Largely forgotten after her death, her work was attributed to Frans Hals or her husband until her 1893 rediscovery.
